ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Apple Developer]Discover what’s next: The biggest updates from WWDC26 | Meet with Apple

ns2:group.ns2:title: Discover what’s next: The biggest updates from WWDC26 | Meet with Apple
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Join us online as we highlight the latest updates across Apple platforms — and explore the benefits for your apps. We'll focus on the why over the how, mapping new technologies to real-world use cases.
This session is for designers, product managers, and engineering leads who drive roadmap decisions and want to learn what’s possible as their teams begin building.
Here’s what we’ll cover:
Intelligence — Discover how to elevate your app experience with foundation models. We’ll explore ways you can incorporate this framework into your existing app, adapt in real time, and anticipate user expectations, empowering your teams to deliver highly intelligent and engaging experiences. Integration — Engage with your users outside of your app. Learn how to leverage App Intents and App Schemas to integrate your content directly with Siri, allowing your product to seamlessly meet users across the entire Apple ecosystem. Adaptability — Modernize your user experience. We'll cover the latest updates to Liquid Glass and how to modernize your app to deliver flawless layouts across any screen size. Tools — Accelerate your time to market. We’ll share significant advances in Apple developer tools that go beyond coding, empowering your design and engineering teams to iterate, prototype, and build together seamlessly.
What’s new for the App Store: Dive into new tools to distribute and market your apps and games, including new creative assets, updates for Apple In-App Purchase and StoreKit, and more.
To explore additional sessions, appointments, and workshops, view the full schedule of Meet with Apple activities worldwide. https://apple.co/Meet-with-Apple
More Apple Developer resources: Video sessions: https://apple.co/VideoSessions Documentation: https://apple.co/DeveloperDocs Forums: https://apple.co/DeveloperForums App: https://apple.co/DeveloperApp
#MeetWithApple #WWDC26

ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Apple]Nido de Villanas: Ep. 1 Don Cristóbal’s inheritance

A microdrama shot on iPhone 17 Pro. Don Cristóbal’s funeral begins, where Renata, Catalina, Beatriz, and Emiliano say goodbye to the patriarch amid fake tears, poisonous thoughts, and a mysterious woman watching from afar. Starring Itatí Cantoral, Gabriela Spanic, Ela Velden, and Mariana Torres.

Durante el funeral de Don Cristóbal, Renata, Catalina, Beatriz y Emiliano despiden al patriarca entre lágrimas falsas, pensamientos venenosos y una misteriosa mujer observando desde lejos. Protagonizada por Itatí Cantoral, Gabriela Spanic, Ela Velden y Mariana Torres.
